title: Save this before you apply to externships (application checklist, format B)

brief.problem: Students apply with the same documents everywhere and miss that each posting asks for different things (certification type, year/standing, references), then run out of time before closing dates.
hooks: save this before you apply to externships
nursing students, read this before applying
the extern application checklist nobody hands you
before you hit submit on your next extern application
not every extern posting asks for the same thing
brief.why: Saveable utility is the strongest save driver in the research (F1: P032, P022, P060), and 'save this' names the action. It travels beyond Ontario: the checklist is general, and the Ontario postings come in only as verified examples on slides 2-3. Rejected: 'nobody hands you' overclaims; 'not every extern posting asks for the same thing' is accurate but a weaker cover than a save prompt.
brief.payoff: A five-point pre-apply checklist: which certification the posting names (with a verified Ontario example), year and academic-standing lines, references, three interview stories, and every closing date in a calendar.
evidence: tiktok-research-2026-11-14 REPORT F1 (saves), CONCEPTS #4 (notes/checklist) and #8 (packing-list checklists)
hooks_captions.md: explicit save CTA (P013, P008); caption ending in a question

slides.title: save this before you apply to externships
check which certification it asks for
slides.body: Women’s College’s posting asks for BCLS. check whether yours says BCLS, BLS or CPR, and get the right one done first.

slides.title: read the year and standing lines
slides.body: some postings only take certain years of study, and some ask for proof of your grades. check both before you start writing.

slides.title: line up references early
slides.body: if a posting asks for references, ask a clinical instructor now, not the night it closes.

slides.title: prep three short stories
slides.body: working on a team, speaking up for someone, and a mistake you learned from. general prep, not any hospital’s official list.

slides.title: put every closing date in your calendar
slides.body: closing dates differ by posting, and some postings don’t list one. add each date the day you find it.

slides.title: looking for postings?
slides.body: lists Ontario extern postings with each one’s listed requirements and closing date, checked against each hospital’s own careers page.
